patch_description: This crossover retains the effective independent input-facing RY layer and parity-shared noncommuting mixers, while replacing the deep serial interaction chain with two disjoint ring matchings. Shared CRZ parameters preserve trainable interactions with fewer effective degrees of freedom, and the distance-two CZ ring retains the broader connectivity associated with lower loss. Distinct pre/post phase parameters avoid the excessive repeated sharing of the current circuit. The result has the same parameter scale as the current candidate but substantially fewer gates and lower interaction depth, targeting faster optimization and better generalization.
